prompt: Convert date-times matching YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss[.fraction](Z|±HH:MM) to their UTC calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD form. Validate Gregorian dates, hours 00–23, minutes and seconds 00–59, and offsets with hours 00–23 and minutes 00–59. This supported subset rejects leap seconds and -00:00 because its offset is unknown. Throw TypeError for malformed or impossible input; the result must not depend on the host time zone.
